title: 第11章 渣男刷存在感被秒-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    #高端小区电梯坠毁#

    #化工厂深夜爆炸或是人为#

    #天机大师今日预言了吗#

    #本周社会事故飙升90%#

    #最近到底怎么了#

    热搜天天标红，热度前十中除了事故就是天机大师。

    自从靳兰玦重生以来，短短四天，人们敏锐发现，气氛确实有点难以言喻的紧张。

    全国各地井喷式发生莫名其妙的事故，在这个网络时代，很多东西不是想压就能压住的。

    网络上数不清的事故现场视频照片流传，人心惶惶，天机大师的名号越传越响，粉丝数量已经快接近五千万。

    她的账号下面没有任何作品，同时又拒收私信，大家只能蹲她的直播间。

    这两天直播间已经没有阴阳怪气吵架，风格慢慢转向。

    【大师，我们真的会迎来灾难吗？】

    【我们的世界到底怎么了？人类还有救吗大师？】

    靳兰玦正在讲分辨诡域的方法，看到满屏的弹幕有点无语。

    “你们悠着点，不然网警叔叔还以为我在发展邪教。”

    【哈哈哈哈哈大师幽默】

    【大师救救我们吧！】

    靳兰玦：“……”

    【真是无语，大师讲得哪句不是自保干货？不好好听就在那儿救救救看得烦死了！】

    【就是！一边道德绑架大师救救你，一边躺平摆烂啥都不干，真当大师直播间是许愿池呢？】

    靳兰玦看到这条弹幕，默默道：

    “别这么说，好像我是许愿池里的王八……”

    【？】

    【哈哈哈哈哈哈】

    “靳兰玦！我想你了！”

    窗外突然响起一个男人的大喊，靳兰玦茫然的表情映在视频中，弹幕都空白了一瞬。

    【啥动静？】

    “靳兰玦！我爱你！我们和好吧！”

    男人的声再次响起。

    【？？？】

    靳兰玦面色一冷，走到窗边往下看。

    就看到清俊的男人一身正装，抱着一大束火红的玫瑰，手里还拿着个大喇叭。

    正是跟她交往了两个月就分手的前任，方言。

    方言看到她，立刻激动地大喊：

    “兰兰！我就知道你会原谅我的！”

    方言……
    第(1/3)页

​ #High-end residential elevator crashed#

​ #The chemical plant exploded late at night or it was man-made#

Did Master Tianji make a prediction today? #

​ #Social accidents surged 90% this week#

​ #What’s going on recently#

"The hot searches are marked red every day, and among the top ten most popular titles besides Accident is Master of Secrets.

Since Jin Lanjue’s rebirth, in just four days, people have keenly discovered that the atmosphere is indeed a little tense.

Inexplicable accidents are happening all over the country. In this Internet age, many things cannot be suppressed just by trying.

Countless videos and photos of the accident scene have been circulated on the Internet, making people panic. The name of Master Tianji is getting more and more popular, and the number of fans has almost reached 50 million.

There are no works under her account, and she refuses to receive private messages, so everyone can only stay in her live broadcast room.

There has been no quarreling in the live broadcast room for the past two days, and the style has gradually changed.

【Master, are we really going to face a disaster?】

【What happened to our world?Can humanity be saved? Master?】

Jin Lanjue was talking about how to distinguish the mysterious realm, and was a little speechless when he saw the barrage filling the screen.

"You guys take it easy, otherwise the Internet police uncle will think I'm developing a cult."

【Hahahahahaha master's humor】

【Master, please save us!】

Jin Lanjue: "..."

【I am really speechless, what did the master say that is not useful for self-protection?If it doesn’t sound good, just stay there. Help, I’m so tired of watching it!】

【that is!While morally kidnapping the master to save you, while lying flat and doing nothing, do you really think that the master's live broadcast room is a wishing fountain?】

Jin Lanjue saw this barrage and said silently:

"Don't say that, as if I'm the bastard in the wishing fountain..."

【?】

【Hahahahahaha】

"Jin Lanjue! I miss you!"

A man’s shout suddenly sounded outside the window. Jin Lanjue’s blank expression was reflected in the video, and the barrage went blank for a moment.

【What's the noise?】

"Jin Lanjue! I love you! Let's make up!"

The man’s voice sounded again.

【???】

Jin Lanjue's face turned cold, and he walked to the window and looked down.

I saw a handsome man in a formal suit, holding a large bouquet of red roses, and holding a big speaker in his hand.

It was her ex, Fang Yan, who broke up with her after dating for two months.

When Fang Yan saw her, he immediately shouted excitedly:

"Lan Lan! I knew you would forgive me!"
